traits.name: Smoke Vision
traits.text: Smoke doesn't impair a red dragon's vision; it ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

traits.name: Dragon Heat
traits.text: (arcane, aura, evocation, fire); 5 feet, 3d6 (3d6) fire damage (DC 30 basic Reflex)

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, fire); The dragon breathes a blast of flame that deals 15d6 (15d6) fire damage in a 50-foot cone (DC 36 basic Reflex save). It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges its Breath Weapon whenever it scores a critical hit with a Strike.
